program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((oh (* h 2))
                (ow (* w 2))
                (pixels (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))
                                (grid-positions g))))
           (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                     (let* ((color (at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                            (sr (- (* 2 (fst p)) 2))
                            (sc (- (* 2 (snd p)) 2)))
                       (reduce (lambda (gg q)
                                 (let ((nr (fst q))
                                       (nc (snd q)))
                                   (if (in-bounds? nr nc oh ow)
                                       (set-cell gg nr nc color)
                                       gg)))
                               acc
                               (positions-in-rect sr sc (+ sr 3) (+ sc 3)))))
                   (empty-grid oh ow 0)
                   pixels))))
